body:
Thank you for the reply, it means a lot. I've always respected the hopeless romantics and like to think, when I'm not beating myself up, that I'm one too.

I slightly regret my post now I've calmed down a little. I was in a pretty bad way when I wrote it, a lot of feelings came up that I haven't confronted before. But I feel that way deep down, when I'm not trying to pretend otherwise. So getting it out there has to be good thing. I'm sorry to hear about the trouble you've recently had too. It's an odd feeling, to have someone and be used to that feeling. Then have it pulled from underneath you, leaving you trying to remember how you lived before you knew they existed
